  \caption{Experiment 1: each dataset's explained PropNEAT network against the comparator suite (binary classification; the survival case is Table~\ref{tab:exp1-benchmarks-survival}). Every comparator is tuned by 5-fold stratified cross-validation on the training rows only (seed 42, scoring AUC), refitted on all training rows, and scored once on the test rows of the split the PropNEAT runs used, with the same input scaling. Each cell: test AUC; below it, the 95\% percentile interval from 10{,}000 bootstrap resamples of the test rows (\texttt{RandomState(42)}, the same resamples for every model of a dataset) and the test accuracy. Bold: the column's best AUC at this precision. Gradient boosting is scikit-learn's histogram gradient boosting; the explainable boosting machine is InterpretML's. The settings each model's cross-validation chose are in \texttt{experiments/benchmarks/benchmarks.csv}. Training / test rows: Heart 242 / 61; MONK-2 345 / 87; Connect-4 cells 54{,}045 / 13{,}512; Connect-4 lines 54{,}045 / 13{,}512; U 1{,}500 / 500; saddle 1{,}500 / 500; U $+$ saddle 1{,}500 / 500. On the synthetic sets the true logit reaches a test AUC of 0.851, 0.841, 0.884 (U, saddle, U $+$ saddle). XOR (four rows, no test set): all 30 PropNEAT seeds classify the four rows; an $L_2$ logistic regression gets 0.50 (it predicts one class) and a decision tree 1.00.}
  \label{tab:exp1-benchmarks}
